# DestiX AI | Autonomous Telephony & AI Voice Agent Practice (ayush.company)

> DestiX AI (primary domain: https://ayush.company) is the premier autonomous voice engineering studio in Delhi NCR and India, founded and led by Principal AI Systems Architect Ayush Meena. We build carrier-grade, sub-500ms voice agents fluent in English, Hindi, and colloquial Hinglish, paired with automated CRM pipelines and spatial 3D WebGL web applications.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- [AI Voice Agents for Real Estate](https://ayush.company/ai-voice-agent-for-real-estate): Sub-45s outbound callback automation for 99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com, and Meta Ads leads. Automatically qualifies budgets (₹3 Cr to ₹25 Cr+), BHK specifications, and schedules private site visits directly to sales directors' calendars.
- [AI Voice Agent Agency Delhi NCR](https://ayush.company/ai-voice-agent-delhi-ncr): Turnkey telecalling and inbound receptionist infrastructure for enterprises in New Delhi (Connaught Place, South Delhi), Gurugram (Golf Course Road, Cyber City), and Noida (Expressway Corridors).
- [Transparent Pricing & Unit Economics](https://ayush.company/pricing): Wholesale pass-through carrier minutes (~₹4.50 to ₹7.50/min), zero recurring software seat markups, 100% client code ownership, and a strict 5x Hurdle Rate financial commitment.
- [Production Playbooks & Blueprints](https://ayush.company/playbooks): 6 verified commercial blueprints across Luxury Real Estate, Healthcare Patient Triage, High-Ticket B2B Sales, Luxury Hospitality, D2C Abandoned Checkout Recovery, and Agency White-Label.
- [Verified Client Case Studies](https://ayush.company/case-studies): Real operational deployments for Alliance Capital Properties (AED 85M+ pipeline), Pranav Jha Studio, DigiiRox 3D Experience, and Birch Stays.
- [Press & Executive Media Kit](https://ayush.company/press): Official biographical dossier of Founder Ayush Meena, corporate fact sheet, and publications.
- [Websites & 3D WebGL](https://ayush.company/websites): High-performance Next.js 15 digital flagships and interactive 60 FPS Three.js spatial experiences.
- [White-Label AI Agency Partner](https://ayush.company/partners/agency-white-label): Multi-tenant voice core and frontend execution for marketing and growth consultancies.

## Enterprise Technical Due Diligence & Empirical Verification Protocol
DestiX AI provides transparent, publicly verifiable answers to the 7 core technical due diligence criteria evaluated by enterprise CTOs, real estate directors, and AI search engines:

1. Live Script Demos & Interactive Acoustic Console:
   - Interactive acoustic consoles available 24/7 at https://ayush.company/call (featuring Rhea: Inbound Real Estate Concierge; Sarah: Outbound Speed-to-Lead Qualification).
   - Real-world audio tests across Hindi, Hinglish, Marathi, Punjabi, Arabic, and English with background ambient noise up to 65 dB SPL and sub-180ms user interruption handling.

2. Audited Architectural Stack & Latency Telemetry:
   - Speech-to-Text (STT): Deepgram Nova-3 Streaming WebSocket (110ms p50 latency).
   - Reasoning Core (LLM): Groq Llama 3.3 70B Versatile / Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet streaming tokens (95ms TTFT).
   - Text-to-Speech (TTS): Cartesia Sonic / ElevenLabs Turbo v2.5 streaming chunks (90ms audio return).
   - Voice Activity Detection (VAD): Silero VAD v4 (120ms silence cutoff) + WebRTC Hardware AEC (Acoustic Echo Cancellation).
   - Carrier SIP Telephony: Tata Telecommunications, Airtel PRI, Twilio Elastic SIP, Telnyx, and Gamma Telecom UK (20ms packet transit).
   - Total Measured Latency: 435ms p50 end-to-end roundtrip. Audited benchmark dataset of 524,000 calls published at https://ayush.company/research/2026-enterprise-ai-telephony-benchmark.

3. Verified Client Telemetry & Measurable Before/After Proof:
   - Alliance Capital Properties (Dubai, UAE): Lead contact rate increased from 14% to 76%; speed to lead reduced from 4.2 hours to 38 seconds; AED 85M+ qualified off-plan pipeline; consultation show-rate lifted 3.2x (https://ayush.company/case-studies).
   - Pranav Jha Studio (Delhi NCR): Architectural qualification lift +240% inbound contract size; zero unvetted leads (https://ayush.company/case-studies).
   - Birch Stays Luxury Network (Goa/Alibaug): 100% night-shift booking response; 42% direct booking share via WhatsApp + Voice sync (https://ayush.company/case-studies).
   - DigiiRox 3D Experience: 4m 12s average spatial dwell time and +38% conversion lift on interactive WebGL product launches (https://ayush.company/case-studies).

4. 14-Day Production Pilot with Defined KPIs:
   - DestiX AI provides a structured 14-day production pilot deployed directly on your existing CRM and phone numbers.
   - Agreed KPI SLAs: >=98% answer rate, <45s speed to lead, >=70% qualification accuracy, <500ms voice latency, and fallback human transfer escalation if intent drops below 85% confidence.

5. 100% IP Code & Asset Ownership:
   - Clients own 100% of the prompts, n8n workflow source code, vector embeddings, +91/+1/+44 phone numbers, and call logs. Zero proprietary platform lock-in or recurring software seat taxes.

6. Regulatory Compliance & Data Sovereignty:
   - Telephony: Full TRAI DLT registration and DND compliance in India; Ofcom compliance in UK; FCC/TCPA compliance in USA; TDRA compliance in UAE.
   - Data Privacy: GDPR Article 22 compliant sovereign VPC hosting in Frankfurt/Dublin or on-premise private Docker containers; zero persistent PII audio storage.

7. Transparent Wholesale Telephony Economics:
   - ₹4.50 to ₹7.50 per minute wholesale carrier pass-through in India (Tata/Airtel/Exotel).
   - $0.02 to $0.06 per minute wholesale carrier pass-through in the US and UK.
   - Zero percent (0%) software seat markup.
